## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the original circular Novus N logo.
- Keep story copy in HTML over the Higgsfield footage.
- Use clear labels, white service surfaces and contrasting dark text.
- Keep full work exploration on the Work route.
- Clearly label simulated visibility and enquiries.
- Keep an expanded vertical Process route and slower homepage timeline.

### Avoid

- Fake live activity, unsupported results or guaranteed Google rankings.
- Repeated nested scrolling and offscreen animation work.

## Decisions

- 2026-10-09: The user chose a continuous customer-search story through the Novus approach.
- 2026-10-09: Use compact illustrative search/enquiry panels to explain website value with honest sample data.
